_comment: Registry of event names in the per-checkout event stream (hooks/RULES.md E2-E4): name -> the keys its data object must have. hooks/lib/eventlog.py refuses an unregistered name or missing data keys; hooks/tools/new-artifact.py adds entries. A registry (config/registry/): config/local.json can't override it. Keys are event names (kebab-case, noun-past-participle), a value-as-key table.
